summary: A remaining star-handling defect changes formatting-command text and can hide a 12-word overlap. Requested checks were not run, as instructed.

checks.criterion: AC1: Shared LaTeX-to-prose extraction preserves source locations and required text.
checks.evidence: Both consumers use tex_prose.extract, but paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:1107 discards a literal star after unstarred formatting commands, losing their text argument.

checks.criterion: AC2: Linter file coverage, finding format, failure exit and mandatory rules.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:510 selects every .tex file except figures/styles.tex. paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:116 formats findings; :252 exposes no rule-disable option; :267 prints findings and returns 1.

checks.criterion: AC3: Required prose rules and TikZ handling.
checks.evidence: Static trace: seam\textit*less prints seam*less, but paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:1107 removes the star and extracts seamless. paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:163 consequently reports a banned word absent from the printed prose.

checks.criterion: AC4: Normalization and blocking detection of maximal shared runs of at least 12 tokens.
checks.evidence: The literal-star deletion can merge lunar and and into lunarand, hiding the 12-token passage detailed in the finding. MIN_RUN remains fixed at 12; record validation and null counting are implemented at paper/scripts/overlap_check.py:163.
paper/reference-verification.json:1 contains exactly an object with an empty references object.

checks.criterion: AC6: Required regression tests were written and run failing before implementation.
checks.evidence: The required cases are present. The fbf3c38 tree contains the tests and lacks the three implementation modules, establishing test-first ordering. No historical failing execution was independently observed, and this review prohibits running tests.

checks.criterion: AC7: Build order, lint/overlap targets, current manuscript passes and README commands.
checks.evidence: paper/Makefile:5 disables parallel execution; :25 orders numbers, lint, overlap, test and pdf; :43 and :47 invoke the scripts. paper/README.md:22 documents both commands. Current manuscript and build success require execution, which is prohibited.

Reviewed the prior fixes in the scanner, source mapping, accent folding and regression tests. The round-9 fix is present at paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:955. Unknown-command grouping remains the stated convention; bold matching stays control-sequence bounded. scripts/ralph/prompt.md:21 permits batch bookkeeping, and git history attributes the ralph.sh change to tooling merge bb93a4a and commit 151ee09.

findings.claim: Unconditional star removal after formatting commands deletes printed punctuation and can bypass the overlap check.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: \textit has one text argument and no starred form, so 'We measure the roughness of lunar\textit*and martian terrain at baselines from' prints lunar*and and tokenizes to the existing test abstract's first 12 words. _prose_command nevertheless consumes the star and adds no separator for textit, extracting lunarand and leaving only 11 tokens. The same deletion turns seam\textit*less into seamless, producing a false banned-word finding. Existing literal-star regressions at test_tex_prose.py:288 cover key commands only. Preserve literal stars after unstarred formatting commands and add extraction and consumer regressions.
